meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会比较当前代码和最新发布版的差异，逐个查看真实改动，按三个发布层列出还没发布的变更及其作用，并为每层和整体各自建议一个版本号。
howto.when: 当用户提到 “unpublished changes”、“changelog”、“what changed” 等触发词时触发。

say.note: Claude 会对比当前代码和最新发布版，分层列出改动。

say.text: 把改动按三个发布层分别列出来。
say.note: 会附带各层应采用的建议版本号。

say.text: 自上次 npm 发布后有什么变化？请给我一份 changelog。
say.note: 会生成变更说明与整体版本推荐。

howto.what_en: On trigger, Claude immediately compares current code to the latest npm release, reads each commit diff, groups unpublished changes by three release layers, explains impact, and suggests version bumps per layer plus overall.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions 'unpublished changes', 'changelog', 'what changed', or similar.

say_en.note: Compares code with latest npm release; gives layered list.

say_en.text: List the changes grouped by the three release layers.
say_en.note: Includes a suggested version bump per layer.

say_en.text: What changed since the last npm publish? Give me a changelog.
say_en.note: Produces change notes and an overall version recommendation.
